subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Please remember: a zoo is not only a place to see animals.”?
options: Quiet support can also deserve applause.
It is also what was saved.
It is also about where people stopped.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Please remember: a zoo is not only a place to see animals. It is also their home.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Quiet support can also deserve applause.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also what was saved.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about where people stopped.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Please remember: a zoo is not only a place to see animals. It is also their home.」，答案為「It is also their home.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is also their home.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
